text: えんりょは　いらんぜ！

structure.jp: えんりょは　いらんぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん is a rough spoken form of ない, the 'not' ending. いらん = 'not needed'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes what you say onto the listener. いらんぜ = 'you don't need it, you know!'.
